<function=python>

def pbox(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
action(['RIGHT','RIGHT','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN'])
print('player after moves', pbox(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward']})
def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append(n['pixels'])
    return {k:sum(v) for k,v in d.items()}
print('after', snap(current_frame))
print('player after space', pbox(current_frame))
# check arch cavities for any non-O fill
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='Y':
        rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        print('Y node', min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols), n['pixels'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def pbox(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
action(['RIGHT','RIGHT','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN'])

action(['SPACE'])
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward']})
def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append(n['pixels'])
    return {k:sum(v) for k,v in d.items()}
print('after', snap(current_frame))
print('player after space', pbox(current_frame))
